sections.label: Store credit

input.text: My Recharge plan includes store credit

sections.hint: Leave this unchecked unless your Recharge plan includes store credit (it is a Plus/Custom feature, not on Starter). Check it only when your plan includes store credit AND the API token has been granted the credit scopes; Gladly then shows the store-credit balance and enables the Adjust store credit action. If checked without the credit scopes, the store-credit calls return a permissions error that prevents the whole Recharge card from loading — so leave it off if in doubt.

sections.label: Maximum credit adjustment
sections.hint: Required only if agents will use the Adjust Credit action, which needs a Recharge plan that includes store credit (the Plus and Custom tiers, not Starter). The largest single store-credit adjustment an agent may make; larger amounts are rejected and must be done by a manager in Recharge. Enter a decimal amount such as 100.00.

sections.label: Maximum delay (billing cycles)
sections.hint: The most billing cycles an agent may delay a subscription's next charge from the Delay next order form. Defaults to 3 if left blank. Enter a whole number such as 3.

sections.label: Maximum subscription price
sections.hint: Required only if agents will use the Adjust subscription price action. The highest line-item price an agent may set from the Adjust subscription price form; larger amounts are rejected and must be done by a manager in Recharge. Enter a decimal amount such as 200.00.

sections.label: Maximum refund amount
sections.hint: Required only if agents will use the Refund charge action. The largest single refund an agent may issue -- the partial amount, or a full charge's remaining balance; larger refunds are rejected and must be done by a manager in Recharge. Enter a decimal amount such as 100.00.

sections.label: API Access Token
sections.hint: Found in the Recharge admin under Tools & Apps > API tokens (API Key)
